<request>
Which form library should we use in React?
</request>
what the project is built with: TypeScript · Next.js, Tailwind CSS · npm
its dependencies: react, react-dom, next, zod
the researched answer (sources [1, 2]):
<data>
For React forms, React Hook Form is the most common choice [1]. It keeps inputs uncontrolled, which means fewer re-renders [1]. Formik is older and re-renders on every change [2]. Both work with Zod through resolvers [1][2].
</data>
